title: Fixed a bug where importing a theme preset (for example `handsontable/themes/static/variables/tokens/main`) or a language dictionary (for example `handsontable/i18n/languages/de-DE`) with a default import in an ES module project using `node16` or `nodenext` module resolution typed it as the module namespace instead of the preset or the dictionary, which made `registerTheme()` fail to compile and `deDE.languageCode` a type error.
